assumptions: Weekly calendar periods; explicit independently supplied scope, vintage and currency.
Amounts in currency major units; positive payment/repayment magnitudes; no FX or netting.
Closing cash includes restricted funds; minimum and effective commitment are caller-owned.
Prepare total_inflows = receipts + financing_inflows and total_outflows = payments + financing_outflows explicitly.
Required checks must be present and evaluated; skipped/error/absent checks mean incomplete coverage.
limitations: No forecast generation, legal eligibility, borrowing-base or intraperiod capacity claim.
Cross-file draw/repayment linkage and first-opening actual tie-out are consumer mapping responsibilities.
Starter expected scope and dates are synthetic examples and must be replaced before use.
